title: The Obedience and Suffering of the Lord's Servant
description: A prophetic speech about the Lord's servant who willingly accepts mockery, blows, and spit without resisting, fully trusting that God is his helper and justifier. The servant describes how the Lord wakes him morning after morning and gives him a tongue of a disciple to encourage the weary. He sets his face like flint and knows he will not be put to shame. Finally, those who walk in darkness are urged to trust in the name of the Lord and lean on their God.
